result.text: Read only: check the current status of " INVENTORY " and list its active incidents. Do not save a note or take an action.

incidents.title: Checkout latency spike
incidents.summary: p99 checkout latency rose from 200ms to 3.5s right after the 08:00 deploy.

incidents.title: Inventory service unavailable
incidents.summary: Inventory pods are crash-looping; stock lookups return HTTP 503.

incidents.title: Elevated payment declines
incidents.summary: Decline rate hit 12% due to an expired downstream certificate; certificate rotated.

incidents.title: Token validation errors
incidents.summary: 5xx from token validation caused by an exhausted connection pool; pool size raised.

incidents.title: Search results slow
incidents.summary: Search p95 degraded after an index rebuild; cache hit-rate dropped to 40%.

incidents.title: Disk full on checkout node
incidents.summary: Log volume filled the disk; rotated logs and expanded the volume.

incidents.title: Cache eviction storm
incidents.summary: A leaking serializer buffer exhausted cache memory and triggered mass evictions; hit-rate fell from 92% to 31%. Root cause of INC-008 and INC-009; fixed by deploying v2026.07.07-2.

incidents.title: Database connection saturation
incidents.summary: Cache misses from INC-007 multiplied read load eightfold and exhausted the connection pool (200/200). Restarting the database did not help; recovered once the cache (INC-007) was fixed.

incidents.title: Checkout latency cascade
incidents.summary: Checkout p99 reached 4.8s while queries queued on the saturated database (INC-008), itself a symptom of the cache eviction storm (INC-007). Latency is recovering; verifying baseline.

incidents.title: Gateway workers degrade over uptime
incidents.summary: Gateway worker RSS climbs about 80MB per hour and p99 latency doubles before each scheduled restart clears it; unclear whether a slow leak or a slow upstream dependency is primary.

services.name: api-gateway
